description: Source-qualified Weiqi Go engine and static/offline web app. Red Cup Engineering owns five rulesets, Go legality, settlement, SGF/replay, semantic events and local bot policies; the existing browser sources offer 9×9/13×13/19×19 normal Play, Capture Go, interactive Learn, Tsumego, Study Replay and glossary. The distinct authenticated online-match and commercial character/commerce capabilities are not received public services from this catalog entry.
entryPointsNote: Current Engineering default apps/weiqi-web/wrangler.jsonc serves static assets and declares weiqi.561.group and weiqi.play.561.group as intended route configurations. It does NOT include a match Worker, Durable Object or proof of a deployed web instance. Source-retained wrangler.online.jsonc is a separate, older candidate stateful match Worker configuration; its source presence is not authenticated multiplayer. Deployment provenance, current host state and independent public player receiving remain unverified by this Science catalog.
seedPolicyNote: Weiqi has no random state transition: the engine accepts a Cartridge seed but does not interpret it, and every bot tier is a function of board state plus an injectable tie-break RNG. The online match fixes no seed policy either; its record is the ordered, principal-attributed command log.
statusNote: Qualified source-state only (2026-10-14): Red Cup weiqi-engine offers legal Go sessions, five local bot policy IDs and source match/settlement/replay machinery. Red Cup weiqi-web has original offline/static playable sources with Study, teaching, puzzle and downloadable records; previous browser/engine changes and exact tests need their current native release build and independent player receipt. Previous source errors regarding match-settlement expectedRevision and finite ruleset/handicap selection have source-level repairs, not attested native whole-suite or live release acceptance. The old Science record's claim that a capability-link two-player Durable Object was deployed by the default Worker was incorrect: default wrangler is static only; online Worker is source-retained and unreceived. This shelf entry cannot certify current uptime, deployed version, paying customers or Lightning payouts.
replayVerifierNote: Source pure verifier for game-command replay with explicit configuration; history/checkpoint consistency does not authenticate remote actor identity, origin or running host.
